question.title: Ca No. 1 (Act 677 - Hb 459) -- Registrar Of Voters

source.name: Louisiana Secretary of State, 2016 Proposed Constitutional Amendments, November 8, 2016 Election (PDF)

ballot_text.source_title: Proposed Amendment No. 1 - Act 677 (2016 Regular Session) amends Article XI, Section 5. (the source does not print the short title used in our id; it prints the amendment number, the Act and the ballot proposition)

fact.quote: Do you support an amendment to provide that the manner of appointment for the registrar of voters in each parish is as provided by law and to require the qualifications of the registrar to be provided by law?
fact.why: The ballot language is about 'the registrar of voters in each parish' and Act 677 amends Art. XI, Sec. 5, which provides that the governing authority of each parish appoints a registrar, so every parish is affected; neither the ballot language nor the Act's text (read in full) names any parish or municipality as the only ones affected. Reading, not a stated finding: it is not an amendment directly affecting not more than five parishes or municipalities. Rule text, Const. art. XIII, Sec. 1(C), read at legis.la.gov (see notes): a majority statewide AND in each affected parish is required only for such a local amendment; any other needs a majority of the electors voting thereon. No true source I read says in so many words that this amendment is or is not local, hence 'inferred'.
